meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 装上后,当你报告 LazyCodex 或 Codex 相关 bug 时,它会先调查并比对最新源码,判断 bug 归属仓库,然后生成结构化英文 GitHub issue(含复现步骤、根因、修复建议),必要时创建 PR,并附 lazycodex-generated 标签。
howto.when: 当你说要报告、提交或处理 LazyCodex、Codex 插件或上游 Codex CLI 等项目的 bug 时触发。

say.text: 我遇到 LazyCodex 安装报错,帮我提交一个 bug issue。
say.note: 它会调查根因并生成英文 issue。

say.text: 这个 Codex 插件的问题该归哪个仓库?帮我分析下。
say.note: 它会比对源码并给出路由结论。

say.text: 把下面的报错整理成 issue,发到 openai/codex。
say.note: 它会检查重复并创建带证据的 issue。

howto.what_en: On bug reports, it investigates latest sources, routes the defect to the owning repo, and drafts a structured English GitHub issue/PR with reproduction steps, root cause, fix guidance, plus the lazycodex-generated label and footer.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to report, file, or triage a LazyCodex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug (or related projects).

say_en.text: I hit a LazyCodex install error; please file a bug issue.
say_en.note: It investigates root cause and drafts an issue.

say_en.text: Which repo should own this Codex plugin bug? Analyze it.
say_en.note: It compares sources and gives a routing result.

say_en.text: Turn the error below into an issue for openai/codex.
say_en.note: It checks duplicates and creates an evidence-backed issue.
